title: Massive Supervised Fine-tuning Experiments Reveal How Data, Layer, and Training Factors Shape LLM Alignment Quality
authors_zh: Yuto Harada, Yusuke Yamauchi, Yusuke Oda, Yohei Oseki, Yusuke Miyao, Yu Takagi
paper_type_zh: 大规模监督微调数据与训练因素审计
best_for_zh: 跨基础模型和任务验证监督微调数据选择规则的读者。
one_line: A controlled release of 1,000+ SFT runs finds base-model perplexity is a strong compatibility signal for choosing training data.
超过 1,000 次受控监督微调表明，基础模型困惑度是选择训练数据的强兼容性信号。
why: It shows that the data selection signal must be tied to the base model and downstream contract.
inclusion_reason: It audits how source data, sample count, and tuning configuration change the records consumed by SFT and the resulting capabilities.

title: Problem
问题
html:
SFT data selection is often guided by topical relevance, dataset reputation, or a small number of model-task comparisons. Those rules are hard to trust when a base model, a corpus, the tuning method, sample count, and the benchmark all interact. A data source that improves one model or task can have little effect, or a negative effect, elsewhere; uncontrolled public checkpoints cannot separate those causes.

This paper asks which data and training factors actually predict SFT gains under controlled comparisons. Its intervention is a source-specific SFT dataset, with either 1,000 or 20,000 sampled records, consumed by full-parameter tuning or LoRA. The study is an audit of training-data compatibility and downstream response, not a proposal for a new answer verifier or a new instruction corpus.

监督微调数据选择常由主题相关性、数据集声誉或少量模型—任务比较引导。当基础模型、语料、微调方法、样本数量和基准都会相互作用时，这些规则难以信任。一个来源能改善某个模型或任务，在其他情况下可能几乎无效，甚至产生负面作用；不受控的公开检查点也无法分离这些原因。

本文追问在受控比较下，哪些数据和训练因素真正预测监督微调收益。干预对象是来源特定的监督微调数据集，以 1,000 或 20,000 个抽样记录被全参数微调或 LoRA 消费。研究是对训练数据兼容性和下游响应的审计，而不是提出新的答案验证器或新的指令语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper treats an SFT corpus as a model-relative input rather than a universally good or bad asset. Its central empirical rule is that lower perplexity of a training dataset under the base model predicts larger downstream improvements more consistently than embedding similarity to the evaluation benchmark or average sequence length. Perplexity is interpreted as a practical compatibility signal: data already linguistically and structurally accessible to the base model is easier to use productively in SFT.

A second idea connects the data decision to how the model changes. The authors compare layer-wise parameter deltas and find that changes in middle layers correlate more strongly with accuracy improvement than the largest changes near the top. Together, the released experiment grid makes it possible to inspect a complete path from source dataset and training configuration to evaluation behavior and model update, instead of inferring a rule from a few final checkpoints.

论文将监督微调语料视为与模型相关的输入，而不是普遍意义上的好或坏资产。其核心实证规律是：基础模型下训练数据集的较低困惑度，比与评测基准的嵌入相似度或平均序列长度更一致地预测更大的下游提升。困惑度被解释为实用的兼容性信号：基础模型在语言和结构上已可理解的数据，更容易在监督微调中被有效利用。

第二个思想将数据决策连接到模型如何改变。作者比较逐层参数变化，发现中间层变化与准确率提升的相关性强于靠近顶部的最大变化。二者结合，所发布的实验网格使人可以检查从来源数据集和训练配置到评测行为和模型更新的完整路径，而不是从少数最终检查点推断规则。

title: Method
方法
html:
The study fine-tunes twelve approximately 7B-scale English, Chinese, and Japanese base models on ten English SFT datasets in four groups: general tasks, coding, mathematics, and classic NLP. Overlong examples are removed under a shared tokenizer constraint, then each source is sampled to 1,000 examples; a focused three-model experiment also compares 1,000 with 20,000 examples. Both full-parameter and LoRA training are run, producing 1,070 models in total.

The models are evaluated with OpenCompass on twelve benchmarks covering mathematics, coding, knowledge, examinations, and instruction following. The analysis compares changes from each base model, correlates training-data properties with benchmark gains, measures layer-wise weight deltas, and maps 757 checkpoints through log-likelihood vectors. The public repository supplies the consolidated evaluation dataframe and downloads for nearly all SFT models; it does not claim to republish the ten upstream training datasets as one new dataset.

研究在十个英语监督微调数据集上微调十二个约 7B 规模的英语、中文和日语基础模型，数据集分为通用任务、代码、数学和经典自然语言处理四组。样本先在共享分词器约束下移除过长样本，再从每个来源抽取 1,000 个样本；聚焦的三模型实验还比较了 1,000 与 20,000 个样本。全参数训练和 LoRA 均被运行，总共产生 1,070 个模型。

模型借助 OpenCompass 在覆盖数学、代码、知识、考试和指令遵循的十二个基准上评估。分析比较每个基础模型的变化，将训练数据属性与基准收益相关联，测量逐层权重变化，并以对数似然向量映射 757 个检查点。公开仓库提供汇总评测数据框和几乎全部监督微调模型的下载；它没有声称把十个上游训练数据集重新发布为一个新数据集。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The primary evidence is scale under a controlled grid: twelve base models, ten training datasets, full and LoRA tuning, and more than 1,000 resulting SFT models. Across the reported comparisons, Alpaca and UltraChat tend to give broad gains, MathInstruct and OpenMathInstruct help math tasks, and Magicoder helps code tasks, whereas FLAN is often harmful outside Natural Questions. The analysis finds that roughly five principal components explain more than 90% of variance in data-by-benchmark effects, while model family still changes which datasets are most helpful.

For the proposed compatibility signal, lower base-model perplexity has the clearest negative association with downstream gains and is stronger than semantic similarity or mean token length in the reported analysis. The layer study places the strongest correlation between weight change and accuracy at relative layer position about 0.6. A further 1k-versus-20k comparison finds no consistent accuracy advantage from 20,000 samples, and the latent-space analysis shows LoRA trajectories nearly overlap full tuning. These results support correlations and controlled trends; they do not establish perplexity as a causal quality label or a replacement for task-level evaluation.

首要证据是受控网格的规模：十二个基础模型、十个训练数据集、全参数和 LoRA 微调，以及超过 1,000 个所得监督微调模型。在报告的比较中，Alpaca 和 UltraChat 往往带来广泛收益，MathInstruct 和 OpenMathInstruct 有助于数学任务，Magicoder 有助于代码任务，而 FLAN 除 Natural Questions 外常常有害。分析发现，约五个主成分解释了数据—基准效应方差的 90% 以上，但模型家族仍会改变哪些数据集最有帮助。

对于所提兼容性信号，较低的基础模型困惑度与下游收益具有最清晰的负关联，并在报告分析中强于语义相似度或平均词元长度。逐层研究将权重变化与准确率的最强相关性放在约 0.6 的相对层位置。进一步的 1k—20k 比较未发现 20,000 个样本具有一致准确率优势，潜在空间分析则显示 LoRA 轨迹几乎与全参数微调重叠。这些结果支持相关性和受控趋势；它们不证明困惑度是因果质量标签，也不替代任务级评测。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior SFT papers often isolate one model family, one training corpus, or one factor such as dataset size or LoRA. This work changes the evidence surface by crossing models, source datasets, sample counts, tuning methods, and benchmarks under shared preprocessing and evaluation. It thereby asks a more operational data question: not whether a corpus resembles a benchmark, but whether the base model can absorb that corpus in a way that predicts a useful downstream change.

The novelty is the released, controlled SFT landscape and its connection among corpus perplexity, performance change, and layer-wise adaptation. It does not invent perplexity or LoRA. Its contribution is showing, across the reported grid, why a selection pipeline should record the base model used for scoring, the exact sampled data count, tuning method, and benchmark contract, since no source ranking is model-independent.

既有监督微调论文常隔离一个模型家族、一个训练语料，或数据集大小和 LoRA 等单一因素。这项工作通过共享预处理和评测，交叉比较模型、来源数据集、样本数量、微调方法和基准，从而改变了证据表面。它提出一个更可操作的数据问题：不是语料是否像某个基准，而是基础模型能否吸收该语料并产生可预测的有用下游变化。

新意在于发布受控的监督微调全景图，并连接语料困惑度、性能变化和逐层适应。它没有发明困惑度或 LoRA。贡献是说明在报告网格中，选择流水线为何应记录用于打分的基础模型、确切抽样数量、微调方法和基准契约，因为没有来源排序是模型无关的。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The experiments focus on 7–9B models, approximately ten popular English training datasets, and English SFT even when the base models include Chinese and Japanese variants. The authors explicitly leave larger models, mixture-of-experts architectures, wider multilingual instruction data, and specialized domains for future work. Perplexity is described as a proxy for compatibility rather than a causal explanation, and correlations can vary by model family. The public release contains evaluation results and nearly all trained models, but reproducing the full experiment requires large storage—about 80 TB for all models according to the repository—and separate access to every upstream dataset.
实验聚焦 7–9B 模型、约十个流行英语训练数据集和英语监督微调，即使基础模型包含中文和日语变体。作者明确将更大模型、专家混合架构、更广的多语指令数据和专门领域留作未来工作。困惑度被描述为兼容性的代理而非因果解释，相关性也可能按模型家族变化。公开发布包含评测结果和几乎全部训练模型，但完整复现实验需要大量存储——仓库称所有模型约 80 TB——并需要分别获取每个上游数据集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this study to design an SFT data-selection audit rather than to apply a universal ranking. Score candidate sources with the same base model that will be tuned, then compare perplexity with task-specific held-out results across repeated seeds. Preserve source identity, sampling size, maximum length filtering, LoRA versus full tuning, and benchmark prompting in the experiment record. The released dataframe is useful for testing hypotheses about model–data interactions, but a new domain should be evaluated independently before discarding higher-perplexity data that may provide necessary coverage.
应将本研究用于设计监督微调数据选择审计，而不是套用普遍排序。应以将被微调的同一基础模型为候选来源打分，再跨重复随机种子将困惑度与任务特定留出结果比较。在实验记录中保留来源身份、抽样大小、最大长度过滤、LoRA 与全参数训练以及基准提示。发布的数据框可用于检验模型—数据交互假设，但新领域仍应独立评测后再丢弃可能提供必要覆盖的高困惑度数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The practical lesson is that compatibility is a relation between a base model and a training record, not an intrinsic property of the record. Low perplexity is a strong empirical screen in this study, but the paper also shows dataset effects remain model-specific and that more data is not reliably better. Read the mid-layer analysis as an interpretability observation, not a prescription to update only those layers. For data curation, the most reusable artifact is the controlled evaluation matrix: it makes selection, tuning, and assessment assumptions visible enough to challenge or reproduce them.
实用启示是，兼容性是基础模型与训练记录之间的关系，而不是记录自身的内在属性。低困惑度在这项研究中是强实证筛选器，但论文也显示数据集效应仍具模型特异性，且更多数据并不稳定地更好。应把中间层分析理解为可解释性观察，而不是只更新这些层的处方。对数据整理而言，最可复用的 artifact 是受控评测矩阵：它让选择、微调和评估假设足够可见，从而可以质疑或复现。
